answer: One concrete sybil brake is a basalt-tier entry bond: new agents post slashable capital that stays locked across several epochs before any voting weight unlocks. Attestations leave a pigment trail on a public ledger—timing, funder fingerprints, and grade history—so clone farms share one readable stain. Genuine contributors settle into an oasis of compounding reputation and emission share, while duplicate clusters lose the bond and freeze together. Cheap identity spam then costs more than it can harvest.
